scope: Present-day reconstruction of the five documented archaeological groups of Cloncurry’s Mount Elliott mill, including the crusher and ramp, roasting furnace and boiler remains, square and circular leaching vats, north electrolytic works, and adobe laboratory foundations.

stories.title: Mount Elliott Company Metallurgical Plant and Mill
